description.zh:
数据库名称。

> **DbName**与**DbNames**二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，**DbNames**优先级高于**DbName**。
description.en:
The database name.

> Specify either **DbName** or **DbNames**. If both parameters are specified, **DbNames** takes precedence over **DbName**.

description.zh:
数据库名称列表，以英文逗号（,）分割，可以实现跨库查询，最大支持10个数据库。
> **DbName**与**DbNames**二选一，如果同时配置了两个参数，**DbNames**优先级高于**DbName**。
description.en:
The list of database names, separated by commas (,). This parameter enables cross-database search and supports up to 10 databases.
> Specify either **DbName** or **DbNames**. If both parameters are specified, **DbNames** takes precedence over **DbName**.

description.zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。URL长度不超过1024个字符。
description.en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~). The URL cannot exceed 1,024 characters in length.

description.zh: 单个人脸列表中搜索人脸结果数量限制，取值范围1~100。
description.en: The maximum number of face search results returned for each face list. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 对输入图像中多少个人脸进行检索比对，控制人脸样本列表个数，取值范围1~10，默认为5。
description.en: The number of faces in the input image to search and compare. This parameter controls the number of face sample lists. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 5.

description.zh: 质量分阈值。对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示人脸图片质量不符合要求，比对失败。取值范围\[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑。
description.en: The quality score threshold. The system performs quality analysis on the face image. If the quality score is lower than this threshold, the face image quality does not meet the requirements and the comparison fails. Valid values: 0.0 to 100.0. A value of 0.0 or an empty value indicates that quality score evaluation is not performed.

descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
人脸搜索能力可以根据输入图片，在数据库中搜索并返回相似的人脸图片数据。单次搜索最多可支持10个人脸数据库的同时搜索（跨库搜索）。该能力根据人脸特征来进行识别，通过把人脸图像特征化，然后比较人脸特征的相似程度。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 当前能力可在视觉智能开放平台有完整的免费产品体验，您可以单击[立即试用](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=SearchFace)对该能力进行更直观试用以及在线购买。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 特色优势
- 识别精度高：人脸检测识别等算法精度处于业内领先水平。
- 识别效率高：毫秒级响应，支持实时识别。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。

><notice>

- 本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
- 如果您是已经在使用的老客户，需要使用海量人脸建库和搜索的能力，请通过钉钉群（23109592）联系我们。

></notice>

3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 前提条件：
- 已通过[创建人脸数据库](~~159141~~)（CreateFaceDb）接口创建了数据库名称（DbName）。
- 已通过[添加人脸样本](~~161144~~)（AddFaceEntity）接口创建了实体ID（EntityId）。
- 已通过[添加人脸数据](~~159216~~)（AddFace）接口给数据库（DbName）下的实体ID（EntityId）添加了人脸图片。

5. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/SearchFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%7D&tab=DEMO)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
6. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

7. 示例代码：该能力常用语言的示例代码，请参见[人脸搜索示例代码](~~478011~~)。

8. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制
- 图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。
- 图像大小：不超过5 MB。
- 图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于4096×4096像素。人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
- 支持图片中包含最多10个人脸，超过部分会被忽略。
>当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见[图片缩放](~~44688~~)。 

## 计费说明
关于人脸搜索1:N的计费方式及报价，请参见[计费介绍](~~184049~~)。人脸搜索1:N能力中仅本接口（SearchFace）收费，其他接口可免费调用。
> 下方调试接口为付费接口，如需免费体验调试请前往[体验中心](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=SearchFace)。
descriptions.en:
## Feature description
The face search feature searches a database for similar face images based on an input image and returns the matching results. A single search supports up to 10 face databases simultaneously (cross-database search). This feature identifies faces based on facial features by converting face images into feature vectors and then comparing the similarity of these feature vectors.

> - You can visit [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for online assistance.
- You can try this feature for free on the China Vision AI Open Platform. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=SearchFace) to try this feature or purchase it online.
- For questions about API integration and usage of Alibaba Cloud Vision AI Open Platform, join the DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Advantages
- High recognition accuracy: The face detection and recognition algorithms achieve industry-leading accuracy.
- High recognition efficiency: Millisecond-level response time with support for real-time recognition.

## Integration guide
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Register Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to complete account registration.
2. Activate the service: Make sure that you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).

><notice>

- This feature is available to enterprise users or users who have completed verify your identity - Individual account. For more information about identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
- If you are an existing customer who needs to use the large-scale face database creation and search feature, contact us through the DingTalk group (23109592).

></notice>

3. Create an AccessKey pair: Make sure that you have [created an AccessKey pair](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Before you begin:
- Create a database name (DbName) by invoking the [CreateFaceDb](~~159141~~) operation.
- Create an entity ID (EntityId) by invoking the [AddFaceEntity](~~161144~~) operation.
- Add face images to the entity ID (EntityId) in the database (DbName) by invoking the [AddFace](~~159216~~) operation.

5. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/SearchFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug this feature online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
6. Development integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from the [SDK overview](~~145033~~).
- Find and install the SDK package for the Face and Body (facebody) AI category in the corresponding SDK documentation.
- Modify the sample code provided in the References as needed and invoke the operation.

7. Sample code: For sample code in commonly used languages, see [Face search sample code](~~478011~~).

8. Direct client calls: Common client call methods for this feature include the following.
- [Direct call from web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct call from mini programs](~~467780~~)
- [Direct call from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct call from iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input limits
- Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
- Image size: up to 5 MB.
- Image resolution: greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 4096 × 4096 pixels. The face must occupy at least 64 × 64 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
- Up to 10 faces in an image are supported. Additional faces are ignored.
>If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image resizing](~~44688~~).

## Billing description
For the billable methods and pricing of face search 1:N, see [Billing overview](~~184049~~). Only this operation (SearchFace) is billed for the face search 1:N feature. Other operations can be invoked for free.
> The debugging operation below is a paid operation. To try it for free, go to the [Experience Center](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=SearchFace).
